headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox continued their winning streak with a 10-0 shutout victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, while the Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1 in a thrilling matchup. The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, and the Baltimore Orioles made a roster move by acquiring outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. in a trade with the Kansas City Royals.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Chris Bassitt being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort, and JoJo Romero being placed on the 15-day injured list with an unspecified injury. Other notable injuries include Brent Rooker's bone bruise in his left knee, Brice Matthews' left knee sprain, Brad Keller's right elbow UCL tear, Tommy Troy's sprained right AC joint, Rob Zastryzny's left trapezius strain, and Drew Millas' left index finger fracture.

The Baltimore Orioles made a trade with the Kansas City Royals, acquiring outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. in exchange for cash considerations. The Houston Astros traded right-hander Lance McCullers Jr., left-hander Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder. The Washington Nationals traded center fielder Robert Hassell III to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them their latest defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key homer on a fly ball to left field.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 5-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox took down the Tampa Bay Rays 5-3, securing a crucial win. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, securing their win behind a strong performance from their lineup. Max Muncy led the charge with a home run and 2 RBI, while Gerrit Cole pitched 6 strong innings for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers in a one-sided matchup, securing a 15-1 victory. Drake Baldwin led the Rangers' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Bassitt Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. This move will impact the team's pitching rotation.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Rudy Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have added outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. to their roster after a trade with the Kansas City Royals. Martin Jr. joins the Orioles in exchange for cash considerations.
